hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); if printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git\s+(push|tag).*v[1-9]'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Cannot push/tag version >=1.0.0 — Nika uses 0.x.x forever' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$FILE" in *Cargo.toml) VERSION=$(grep -E '^version\s*=\s*"' "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/nika/Cargo.toml" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/.*"\(.*\)".*/\1/'); if [ -n "$VERSION" ] && echo "$VERSION" | grep -qE '^[1-9]'; then echo "VERSION LOCK: $VERSION detected — Nika must stay 0.x.x" >&2; exit 2; fi;; *CHANGELOG.md) if ! head -50 "$FILE" | grep -q '╔═'; then echo 'CHANGELOG: Missing ASCII banner — see release-formatting rule' >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac; exit 0
